_comment: Fallback credentials for the hosted copy, which has no way to set env
vars. Environment variables always win over anything in this file, so a
deployment that sets SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_KEY (or connects Upstash)
The key below is Supabase's *publishable* key. It is the one meant to ship
to browsers, and it can only reach the millionaire_kv table -- row level
security keeps every other table in the project out of its reach.
